```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(googlesheets4)
library(scales)
library(htmltools)
library(reactable)
library(htmlwidgets)

# flexdashboard: passing caption= replaces the whole caption and drops the ### title — keep both via HTML
vb_caption <- function(title, detail) {
  HTML(sprintf(
    '<span class="vb-title">%s</span><span class="vb-detail">%s</span>',
    htmlEscape(title),
    htmlEscape(detail, attribute = FALSE)
  ))
}

# ============================
# CONFIG
# ============================
# Auth: GOOGLE_SA_JSON (full JSON string) for Posit Connect; GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH for local dev
GOOGLE_SA_JSON <- Sys.getenv("GOOGLE_SA_JSON", unset = "")
GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH <- Sys.getenv("GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH", unset = "")
AUTOMATION_SHEET_ID <- Sys.getenv("AUTOMATION_SHEET_ID", unset = "")
AUTOMATION_SHEET_TAB <- Sys.getenv("AUTOMATION_SHEET_TAB", unset = "UI")
RELEASE_DEPLOYMENT_SHEET_TAB <- Sys.getenv("RELEASE_DEPLOYMENT_SHEET_TAB", unset = "Release Deployment")
RUNS_SHEET_RANGE <- Sys.getenv("RUNS_SHEET_RANGE", unset = "A:D")
RUNS_TZ <- Sys.getenv("RUNS_TZ", unset = "UTC")

# ============================
# DESIGN SYSTEM (MATCH SHORTCUT)
# ============================
BASE_THEME <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#1f1f1f", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#1f1f1f", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#333333"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(color = "#e6e6e6"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#cccccc"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#cccccc"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#aaaaaa"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#1f1f1f"),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "#1f1f1f"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#e6e6e6"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#e6e6e6")
  )

plotly_title <- function(text) {
  list(
    text = paste0("<b>", text, "</b>"),
    x = 0.02,
    xanchor = "left",
    font = list(size = 14, color = "#e6e6e6")
  )
}

add_plotly_border <- function(p, color = "#333333", width = 1) {
  p %>% layout(
    shapes = list(
      list(
        type = "rect",
        xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
        x0 = 0, y0 = 0, x1 = 1, y1 = 1,
        line = list(color = color, width = width),
        fillcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
      )
    )
  )
}

# Goal reference: Paul Tol wine — CB-safe, distinct from pass-rate cyan (#5bc0de)
GOAL_LINE_COLOR <- "#882255"
AUTOMATION_PASS_RATE_GOAL <- 0.85
RELEASE_PASS_RATE_GOAL <- 0.95

pass_rate_goal_gg_hline <- function(yintercept) {
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = yintercept,
    color = GOAL_LINE_COLOR,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )
}

pass_rate_goal_annotation <- function(goal) {
  list(
    list(
      xref = "paper",
      x = 0.02,
      yref = "y",
      y = goal,
      text = paste0("Goal (", scales::percent(goal, accuracy = 1), ")"),
      showarrow = FALSE,
      xanchor = "left",
      font = list(color = GOAL_LINE_COLOR, size = 11),
      bgcolor = "rgba(31,31,31,0.88)",
      bordercolor = GOAL_LINE_COLOR,
      borderwidth = 1,
      borderpad = 4
    )
  )
}

# ============================
# COVERAGE & AUTOMATION STATUS (CB-safe, single source of truth)
# Okabe–Ito: bluish green vs vermillion reads as good/bad without a pure red–green scale
# (see https://jfly.uni-koeln.de/color/ )
COVERAGE_GRADIENT_LOW <- "#D55E00"   # vermillion — lower coverage
COVERAGE_GRADIENT_HIGH <- "#009E73" # bluish green — higher coverage

AUTOMATION_STATUS_COLORS <- c(
  "Automated"       = "#009E73",
  "Not Automated"   = "#D55E00",
  "Not Required"    = "#56B4E9",
  "Cannot Automate" = "#7F7F7F"
)

# Heatmap / table cells: same endpoints as ggplot coverage gradients, stepped for readability
.coverage_pct_ramp <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  c(COVERAGE_GRADIENT_LOW, COVERAGE_GRADIENT_HIGH),
  space = "Lab"
)(6L)

coverage_heatmap_bin_color <- function(value) {
  if (is.na(value)) return("transparent")
  if (value >= 80) return(.coverage_pct_ramp[[6]])
  if (value >= 60) return(.coverage_pct_ramp[[5]])
  if (value >= 40) return(.coverage_pct_ramp[[4]])
  if (value >= 20) return(.coverage_pct_ramp[[3]])
  if (value > 0)   return(.coverage_pct_ramp[[2]])
  .coverage_pct_ramp[[1]]
}

coverage_cell_text_color <- function(bg_hex) {
  if (identical(bg_hex, "transparent") || is.na(bg_hex)) return("#888888")
  rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(bg_hex) / 255
  lin <- ifelse(rgb <= 0.03928, rgb / 12.92, ((rgb + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4)
  lum <- as.numeric(c(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722) %*% lin)
  if (lum < 0.42) "#f5f5f5" else "#121212"
}

# Failure attribution stacked bars — Paul Tol Bright qualitative (CB-safe)
# https://personal.sron.nl/~pault/
ATTRIBUTION_COLORS <- c(
  "Test Bug"        = "#66CCEE",
  "Product Change"  = "#CCBB44",
  "Product Bug"     = "#EE6677",
  "Platform Issue"  = "#AA3377",
  "Needs Triage"    = "#BBBBBB"
)

# ============================
# DATA
# ============================
auth_gs <- function() {
  if (nzchar(GOOGLE_SA_JSON)) {
    googlesheets4::gs4_auth(path = GOOGLE_SA_JSON)  # path accepts JSON string (Posit Connect)
  } else if (nzchar(GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH) && file.exists(GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH)) {
    googlesheets4::gs4_auth(path = GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH)
  } else {
    stop("Set GOOGLE_SA_JSON (Posit Connect) or GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH (local) with valid credentials")
  }
}

read_runs <- function() {
  auth_gs()
  googlesheets4::read_sheet(
    ss = AUTOMATION_SHEET_ID,
    sheet = AUTOMATION_SHEET_TAB,
    range = RUNS_SHEET_RANGE,
    col_types = "cccc"
  )
}

clean_runs <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    rename_with(~str_trim(.x)) %>%
    mutate(
      Date = parse_date_time(
        Date,
        orders = c("ymd HMS", "mdy HMS", "ymd HM", "mdy HM", "ymd", "mdy"),
        tz = RUNS_TZ
      ),
      `Run Type` = str_to_title(str_trim(`Run Type`)),
      Result = str_to_title(str_trim(Result)),
      `Failure Attribution` = if_else(
        is.na(`Failure Attribution`) | str_trim(`Failure Attribution`) == "",
        NA_character_,
        str_to_title(str_trim(`Failure Attribution`))
      ),
      Run_Day = as_date(Date)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Date), Result %in% c("Pass", "Fail"))
}

runs_data <- read_runs() %>% clean_runs()
latest_run_at <- max(runs_data$Date, na.rm = TRUE)

# Release Deployment data (separate tab)
read_release_deployment_runs <- function() {
  auth_gs()
  googlesheets4::read_sheet(
    ss = AUTOMATION_SHEET_ID,
    sheet = RELEASE_DEPLOYMENT_SHEET_TAB,
    range = RUNS_SHEET_RANGE,
    col_types = "cccc"
  )
}

clean_release_runs <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    rename_with(~str_trim(.x)) %>%
    mutate(
      Date = parse_date_time(
        Date,
        orders = c("ymd HMS", "mdy HMS", "ymd HM", "mdy HM", "ymd", "mdy"),
        tz = RUNS_TZ
      ),
      Result = str_to_title(str_trim(Result)),
      Run_Day = as_date(Date)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Date), Result %in% c("Pass", "Fail"))
}

release_deployment_data <- tryCatch(
  read_release_deployment_runs() %>% clean_release_runs(),
  error = function(e) tibble(Date = as.POSIXct(character()), Result = character(), Run_Day = as.Date(character()))
)
```

Summary
=====================================

Row {data-height=100}
-------------------------------------

### Quality Velocity Score

```{r quality_velocity_composite}
# Calculate composite Quality Velocity Score (0-100)
# Components:
# - Pass Rate (40% weight)
# - Triage Efficiency (30% weight) - inverse of untriaged rate
# - Escape Rate (30% weight) - inverse of escape rate

# Get component values
pass_rate_component <- kpi_7d$Pass_Rate
if (is.na(pass_rate_component)) pass_rate_component <- 0

triage_efficiency <- 1 - failures_30d$Needs_Triage_Rate

# Calculate escape rate inline (from release failures)
failed_releases <- release_deployment_data %>%
  filter(Run_Day >= last_30_cutoff, Result == "Fail") %>%
  nrow()
total_releases <- release_deployment_data %>%
  filter(Run_Day >= last_30_cutoff) %>%
  nrow()
escape_rate_val <- if (total_releases > 0) failed_releases / total_releases else 0

escape_component <- 1 - escape_rate_val

# Calculate weighted score
quality_velocity_score <- (
  pass_rate_component * 0.40 +
  triage_efficiency * 0.30 +
  escape_component * 0.30
) * 100

# Determine status
score_status <- case_when(
  quality_velocity_score >= 85 ~ "excellent",
  quality_velocity_score >= 70 ~ "good",
  quality_velocity_score >= 50 ~ "fair",
  TRUE ~ "needs_work"
)

score_color <- case_when(
  score_status == "excellent" ~ "success",
  score_status == "good" ~ "primary",
  score_status == "fair" ~ "warning",
  TRUE ~ "danger"
)

valueBox(
  value = round(quality_velocity_score),
  caption = vb_caption(
    "Quality Velocity Score",
    paste0(
      "Pass Rate: ", scales::percent(pass_rate_component, accuracy = 1), " (40%)",
      " | Triage: ", scales::percent(triage_efficiency, accuracy = 1), " (30%)",
      " | Escape: ", scales::percent(escape_component, accuracy = 1), " (30%)"
    )
  ),
  color = score_color
)
```

Row
-------------------------------------

```{r exec_kpi_pass_rate_7d}
latest_day <- max(runs_data$Run_Day, na.rm = TRUE)
last_7_cutoff <- latest_day - days(6)

kpi_7d <- runs_data %>%
  filter(Run_Day >= last_7_cutoff) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    Passed = sum(Result == "Pass"),
    Failed = sum(Result == "Fail"),
    Pass_Rate = if_else(Total == 0, NA_real_, Passed / Total)
  )

valueBox(
  value = ifelse(is.na(kpi_7d$Pass_Rate), "N/A", scales::percent(kpi_7d$Pass_Rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
  caption = vb_caption(
    "7-day pass rate",
    paste0("Last 7 days • ", kpi_7d$Passed, " / ", kpi_7d$Total, " runs passed")
  ),
  color = ifelse(is.na(kpi_7d$Pass_Rate), "primary", ifelse(kpi_7d$Pass_Rate >= 0.95, "success", ifelse(kpi_7d$Pass_Rate >= 0.85, "warning", "danger")))
)
```

### Failed Runs (7 Days)

```{r exec_kpi_fails_7d}
valueBox(
  value = scales::comma(kpi_7d$Failed),
  caption = vb_caption(
    "Failed runs (7d)",
    paste0("Last 7 days • ", scales::comma(kpi_7d$Total), " total runs")
  ),
  color = ifelse(kpi_7d$Failed == 0, "success", ifelse(kpi_7d$Failed <= 5, "warning", "danger"))
)
```

### Untriaged Failures (30 Days)

```{r exec_kpi_untriaged_30d}
last_30_cutoff <- latest_day - days(29)

failures_30d <- runs_data %>%
  filter(Run_Day >= last_30_cutoff, Result == "Fail") %>%
  mutate(
    `Failure Attribution` = if_else(
      is.na(`Failure Attribution`) | str_trim(`Failure Attribution`) == "",
      "Needs Triage",
      `Failure Attribution`
    )
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Failures = n(),
    Needs_Triage = sum(`Failure Attribution` == "Needs Triage"),
    Needs_Triage_Rate = if_else(Total_Failures == 0, 0, Needs_Triage / Total_Failures)
  )

valueBox(
  value = scales::percent(failures_30d$Needs_Triage_Rate, accuracy = 0.1),
  caption = vb_caption(
    "Untriaged share (30d)",
    paste0(failures_30d$Needs_Triage, " of ", failures_30d$Total_Failures, " failures still untriaged")
  ),
  color = ifelse(failures_30d$Needs_Triage_Rate <= 0.05, "success", ifelse(failures_30d$Needs_Triage_Rate <= 0.15, "warning", "danger"))
)
```

### Defect Escape Rate (90 Days)

```{r escape_rate_kpi_summary}
# This would typically come from shortcut-bugs-dashboard data
# For now, calculate based on release data correlation
# If there are failed releases, that indicates escaped defects

failed_releases_90d <- release_deployment_data %>%
  filter(Run_Day >= last_30_cutoff, Result == "Fail") %>%
  nrow()

total_releases_90d <- release_deployment_data %>%
  filter(Run_Day >= last_30_cutoff) %>%
  nrow()

escape_rate <- if (total_releases_90d > 0) failed_releases_90d / total_releases_90d else 0

valueBox(
  value = scales::percent(escape_rate, accuracy = 0.1),
  caption = vb_caption(
    "Release Failure Rate (30d)",
    paste0(failed_releases_90d, " failed / ", total_releases_90d, " releases")
  ),
  color = ifelse(escape_rate <= 0.05, "success", ifelse(escape_rate <= 0.10, "warning", "danger"))
)
```

### Release Deployment Pass Rate (30 Days)

```{r exec_kpi_release_pass_rate_30d}
release_30d <- release_deployment_data %>%
  filter(Run_Day >= last_30_cutoff) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    Passed = sum(Result == "Pass"),
    Pass_Rate = if_else(Total == 0, NA_real_, Passed / Total)
  )

valueBox(
  value = ifelse(is.na(release_30d$Pass_Rate), "N/A", scales::percent(release_30d$Pass_Rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
  caption = ifelse(
    release_30d$Total == 0,
    vb_caption("Release pass rate (30d)", "No release deployment runs in the last 30 days"),
    vb_caption(
      "Release pass rate (30d)",
      paste0("Last 30 days • ", release_30d$Passed, " / ", release_30d$Total, " release runs passed")
    )
  ),
  color = ifelse(is.na(release_30d$Pass_Rate), "primary", ifelse(release_30d$Pass_Rate >= 0.95, "success", ifelse(release_30d$Pass_Rate >= 0.85, "warning", "danger")))
)
```

```{r monthly_avg_pass_rate}
monthly_df <- runs_data %>%
  group_by(
    Month = floor_date(Run_Day, "month")
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    Passed = sum(Result == "Pass"),
    Avg_Pass_Rate = Passed / Total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Month)

p <- ggplot(
  monthly_df,
  aes(
    Month,
    Avg_Pass_Rate,
    group = 1,
    text = paste0(
      "Month: ", format(Month, "%b %Y"),
      "<br>Avg Pass Rate: ", scales::percent(Avg_Pass_Rate, accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  )
) +
  geom_line(color = "#5bc0de", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#5bc0de", size = 2) +
  pass_rate_goal_gg_hline(AUTOMATION_PASS_RATE_GOAL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Average Pass Rate") +
  BASE_THEME

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
  layout(
    title = plotly_title("Average Passing Rate per Month"),
    plot_bgcolor = "#1f1f1f",
    paper_bgcolor = "#1f1f1f",
    yaxis = list(tickformat = ".0%"),
    annotations = pass_rate_goal_annotation(AUTOMATION_PASS_RATE_GOAL)
  ) %>%
  add_plotly_border()
```

```{r daily_failures_by_attribution}
attribution_levels <- c(
  "Test Bug",
  "Product Change",
  "Product Bug",
  "Platform Issue",
  "Needs Triage"
)

df <- runs_data %>%
  filter(Result == "Fail") %>%
  mutate(
    `Failure Attribution` = if_else(
      is.na(`Failure Attribution`),
      "Needs Triage",
      `Failure Attribution`
    )
  ) %>%
  count(Run_Day, `Failure Attribution`, name = "Failures") %>%
  complete(
    Run_Day,
    `Failure Attribution` = attribution_levels,
    fill = list(Failures = 0)
  )

p <- ggplot(
  df,
  aes(Run_Day, Failures, fill = `Failure Attribution`)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ATTRIBUTION_COLORS) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Failures") +
  BASE_THEME +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggplotly(p) %>%
  layout(
    title = plotly_title("Daily Failures by Attribution"),
    barmode = "stack",
    plot_bgcolor = "#1f1f1f",
    paper_bgcolor = "#1f1f1f",
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.02, y = -0.25)
  ) %>%
  add_plotly_border()
```

```{r load_browserstack_data, include=FALSE}
# ============================
# BROWSERSTACK COVERAGE DATA
# ============================
# Try live fetch first; fall back to bundled CSV
BROWSERSTACK_API_KEY <- Sys.getenv("BROWSERSTACK_API_KEY", unset = "")

if (nzchar(BROWSERSTACK_API_KEY) && file.exists("fetch_browserstack_data.R")) {
  source("fetch_browserstack_data.R", local = TRUE)
  bs_data <- tryCatch(fetch_browserstack_test_cases(), error = function(e) NULL)
}

if (!exists("bs_data") || is.null(bs_data)) {
  if (file.exists("browserstack_test_cases.csv")) {
    bs_data <- read.csv("browserstack_test_cases.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    bs_data <- tibble(
      identifier = character(), title = character(),
      top_level_folder = character(), second_level_folder = character(),
      full_path = character(), folder_id = character(),
      automation_status = character(), priority = character(),
      status = character(), case_type = character(),
      owner = character(), created_at = character(),
      last_updated_at = character()
    )
  }
}

bs_data <- bs_data %>%
  mutate(
    automation_status = case_when(
      automation_status == "automated" ~ "Automated",
      automation_status == "not_automated" ~ "Not Automated",
      automation_status == "automation_not_required" ~ "Not Required",
      automation_status == "cannot_be_automated" ~ "Cannot Automate",
      TRUE ~ automation_status
    ),
    priority = case_when(
      tolower(priority) %in% c("medium", "meidum", "edium", "medum") ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ priority
    ),
    is_automated = automation_status == "Automated"
  )

total_cases <- nrow(bs_data)
total_automated <- sum(bs_data$is_automated)
overall_pct <- if (total_cases > 0) total_automated / total_cases else 0
```

### Automated

```{r cov_kpi_automated}
valueBox(
  value = scales::comma(total_automated),
  caption = vb_caption(
    "Automated",
    paste0(scales::percent(overall_pct, accuracy = 0.1), " of all test cases")
  ),
  color = ifelse(overall_pct >= 0.50, "success", ifelse(overall_pct >= 0.25, "warning", "danger"))
)
```

### Not Automated

```{r cov_kpi_not_automated}
not_auto <- sum(bs_data$automation_status == "Not Automated")
not_auto_pct <- if (total_cases > 0) not_auto / total_cases else 0
valueBox(
  value = scales::comma(not_auto),
  caption = vb_caption(
    "Not automated",
    paste0(scales::percent(not_auto_pct, accuracy = 0.1), " — automation opportunity")
  ),
  color = ifelse(not_auto_pct <= 0.30, "success", ifelse(not_auto_pct <= 0.60, "warning", "danger"))
)
```

### Not Required / Cannot Automate

```{r cov_kpi_excluded}
excluded <- sum(bs_data$automation_status %in% c("Not Required", "Cannot Automate"))
excluded_pct <- if (total_cases > 0) excluded / total_cases else 0
valueBox(
  value = scales::comma(excluded),
  caption = vb_caption(
    "Not required / Cannot automate",

)
```

Coverage Heatmap
=====================================

Row
-------------------------------------

###

```{r coverage_heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=14}
# Heatmap: one row per top-level folder; click the row to expand subfolders
# (second_level_folder) in a nested table. Columns = coverage % by priority.

heatmap_data <- bs_data %>%
  group_by(top_level_folder, second_level_folder, priority) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    Automated = sum(is_automated),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Total per sub-area (across all priorities)
area_totals <- bs_data %>%
  group_by(top_level_folder, second_level_folder) %>%
  summarise(
    area_total = n(),
    area_automated = sum(is_automated),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Total_Pct = if_else(area_total == 0, NA_real_, 100 * area_automated / area_total))

# Per-priority coverage (leaf rows) — keep pct + raw counts so cells can show both
priority_pcts <- heatmap_data %>%
  mutate(pct = if_else(Total == 0, NA_real_, 100 * Automated / Total)) %>%
  select(top_level_folder, second_level_folder, priority, pct, Automated, Total) %>%
  rename(auto = Automated, total = Total) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = priority,
    values_from = c(pct, auto, total),
    names_glue = "{priority}_{.value}",
    values_fill = list(pct = NA_real_, auto = 0L, total = 0L)
  ) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("_pct$", "", .x), ends_with("_pct"))

# Child rows: one per (top, second) — shown inside expandable details
child_df <- area_totals %>%
  left_join(priority_pcts, by = c("top_level_folder", "second_level_folder")) %>%
  arrange(top_level_folder, desc(Total_Pct)) %>%
  mutate(
    Test_Area = if_else(
      is.na(second_level_folder) | second_level_folder == "",
      "\u2014",
      as.character(second_level_folder)
    ),
    Cases = area_total,
    Total_Pct_auto = area_automated,
    Total_Pct_total = area_total
  ) %>%
  select(
    top_level_folder, Test_Area, Cases,
    Total_Pct, Total_Pct_auto, Total_Pct_total,
    Critical, Critical_auto, Critical_total,
    High, High_auto, High_total,
    Medium, Medium_auto, Medium_total,
    Low, Low_auto, Low_total
  )

child_by_top <- split(child_df, child_df$top_level_folder)

# Parent rows: rolled up to top_level_folder only
parent_area_totals <- bs_data %>%
  group_by(top_level_folder) %>%
  summarise(
    area_total = n(),
    area_automated = sum(is_automated),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Total_Pct = if_else(area_total == 0, NA_real_, 100 * area_automated / area_total))

parent_priority_pcts <- bs_data %>%
  group_by(top_level_folder, priority) %>%
  summarise(Total = n(), Automated = sum(is_automated), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pct = if_else(Total == 0, NA_real_, 100 * Automated / Total)) %>%
  select(top_level_folder, priority, pct, Automated, Total) %>%
  rename(auto = Automated, total = Total) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = priority,
    values_from = c(pct, auto, total),
    names_glue = "{priority}_{.value}",
    values_fill = list(pct = NA_real_, auto = 0L, total = 0L)
  ) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("_pct$", "", .x), ends_with("_pct"))

parent_df <- parent_area_totals %>%
  left_join(parent_priority_pcts, by = "top_level_folder") %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Pct)) %>%
  mutate(
    Test_Area = as.character(top_level_folder),
    Cases = area_total,
    Total_Pct_auto = area_automated,
    Total_Pct_total = area_total
  ) %>%
  select(
    top_level_folder, Test_Area, Cases,
    Total_Pct, Total_Pct_auto, Total_Pct_total,
    Critical, Critical_auto, Critical_total,
    High, High_auto, High_total,
    Medium, Medium_auto, Medium_total,
    Low, Low_auto, Low_total
  )

# Reactable cells: same coverage ramp as bar charts (setup: COVERAGE_GRADIENT_*).
# Each cell shows two tiers — primary % (drives heatmap color + sort) and a
# secondary automated/total fraction so readers can judge the denominator.
# "No cases" at a priority renders as an em-dash with no fill, visually distinct
# from 0% coverage with cases.
pct_col_def <- function(display_name, df) {
  colDef(
    name = display_name,
    align = "center",
    minWidth = 95,
    cell = function(value, index, name) {
      auto_col  <- paste0(name, "_auto")
      total_col <- paste0(name, "_total")
      auto  <- if (auto_col  %in% names(df)) df[[auto_col]][[index]]  else NA_integer_
      total <- if (total_col %in% names(df)) df[[total_col]][[index]] else NA_integer_

      if (is.na(total) || total == 0L) {
        htmltools::div(
          style = paste(
            "display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;",
            "justify-content:center;line-height:1.1;"
          ),
          htmltools::div(style = "font-size:14px;color:#666;", "\u2014"),
          htmltools::div(style = "font-size:10px;color:#666;opacity:.8;", "no cases")
        )
      } else {
        htmltools::div(
          style = paste(
            "display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;",
            "justify-content:center;line-height:1.15;",
            "font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;"
          ),
          htmltools::div(
            style = "font-size:14px;font-weight:700;",
            if (is.na(value)) "\u2014" else sprintf("%.0f%%", value)
          ),
          htmltools::div(
            style = "font-size:10px;opacity:.75;",
            sprintf("%d/%d", as.integer(auto), as.integer(total))
          )
        )
      }
    },
    style = function(value, index, name) {
      total_col <- paste0(name, "_total")
      total <- if (total_col %in% names(df)) df[[total_col]][[index]] else NA_integer_
      if (is.na(total) || total == 0L) {
        list(
          background = "transparent",
          color = "#666",
          textAlign = "center",
          borderRadius = "2px"
        )
      } else {
        bg <- coverage_heatmap_bin_color(value)
        fg <- coverage_cell_text_color(bg)
        list(
          background = bg,
          color = fg,
          fontWeight = "bold",
          textAlign = "center",
          borderRadius = "2px"
        )
      }
    }
  )
}

hidden_col <- colDef(show = FALSE)

heatmap_theme <- reactableTheme(
  backgroundColor = "#1f1f1f",
  color = "#e6e6e6",
  borderColor = "#333333",
  stripedColor = "#2a2a2a",
  highlightColor = "#333333",
  headerStyle = list(
    backgroundColor = "#121417",
    color = "#e6e6e6",
    fontWeight = "bold",
    borderBottom = "2px solid #5bc0de"
  )
)

parent_columns <- list(
  top_level_folder = hidden_col,
  Test_Area = colDef(
    name = "Test Area",
    minWidth = 250,
    style = list(fontWeight = "600")
  ),
  Cases = hidden_col,
  Total_Pct       = pct_col_def("Total",  parent_df),
  Total_Pct_auto  = hidden_col,
  Total_Pct_total = hidden_col,
  Critical        = pct_col_def("Critical", parent_df),
  Critical_auto   = hidden_col,
  Critical_total  = hidden_col,
  High            = pct_col_def("High",     parent_df),
  High_auto       = hidden_col,
  High_total      = hidden_col,
  Medium          = pct_col_def("Medium",   parent_df),
  Medium_auto     = hidden_col,
  Medium_total    = hidden_col,
  Low             = pct_col_def("Low",      parent_df),
  Low_auto        = hidden_col,
  Low_total       = hidden_col
)

# child_columns is rebuilt per-expansion inside details() so pct_col_def closes
# over the specific sub-frame being rendered (needed for index-based lookups).
make_child_columns <- function(sub) {
  list(
    top_level_folder = hidden_col,
    Test_Area = colDef(
      name = "Subfolder",
      minWidth = 220,
      style = list(fontWeight = "400", color = "#cccccc")
    ),
    Cases = hidden_col,
    Total_Pct       = pct_col_def("Total",  sub),
    Total_Pct_auto  = hidden_col,
    Total_Pct_total = hidden_col,
    Critical        = pct_col_def("Critical", sub),
    Critical_auto   = hidden_col,
    Critical_total  = hidden_col,
    High            = pct_col_def("High",     sub),
    High_auto       = hidden_col,
    High_total      = hidden_col,
    Medium          = pct_col_def("Medium",   sub),
    Medium_auto     = hidden_col,
    Medium_total    = hidden_col,
    Low             = pct_col_def("Low",      sub),
    Low_auto        = hidden_col,
    Low_total       = hidden_col
  )
}

reactable(
  parent_df,
  defaultSorted = list(Total_Pct = "desc"),
  defaultPageSize = 60,
  compact = TRUE,
  borderless = FALSE,
  striped = FALSE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  theme = heatmap_theme,
  details = function(index) {
    i <- if (length(index)) as.integer(index[[1]]) else NA_integer_
    if (is.na(i) || i < 1L || i > nrow(parent_df)) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    tl <- parent_df$top_level_folder[[i]]
    sub <- child_by_top[[tl]]
    if (is.null(sub) || nrow(sub) == 0L) {
      return(div(
        style = "padding:10px 2rem;color:#888;font-size:13px;",
        "No subfolder rows for this area."
      ))
    }
    div(
      style = "margin:0;padding:6px 0 10px 1.75rem;background:#151515;border-left:2px solid #5bc0de;",
      reactable(
        sub,
        compact = TRUE,
        borderless = FALSE,
        striped = FALSE,
        highlight = FALSE,
        theme = heatmap_theme,
        columns = make_child_columns(sub),
        pagination = FALSE
      )
    )
  },
  columns = parent_columns
)
```
